name: Plane Flitter
body:
You are native of this plane, and have learned much of its peculiarities and customs.

Prerequisite(s): Ouphe; must be taken at 1st level

Benefit(s): You gain proficiency with an exotic weapon of your choice and you gain a +1 bonus to all Knowledge skills.
